name: Liquid type
look: A very large headline ripples and stretches like type seen through water wherever the pointer crosses it, and settles back to crisp type within about a second; one SVG filter, only while it moves.
reduced: The headline stands as written; also on touch screens.
phone: The headline stands as written; there is no pointer.

needs.words: a headline of 2 to 6 words, set large
